scripts.smoke: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run smoke && npm run test:backend && npm run simulator:workspace:check:fixtures && npm run test
scripts.simulator:workspace:check: sh -c 'PYTHON=${URDF_STUDIO_PYTHON:-}; if [ -z "$PYTHON" ]; then if [ -x .venv/bin/python3 ]; then PYTHON=.venv/bin/python3; else PYTHON=python3; fi; fi; "$PYTHON" -m backend.scripts.simulator_workspace_check "$@"' --
scripts.simulator:workspace:check:fixtures: npm run simulator:workspace:check -- --fixture demo && npm run simulator:workspace:check -- --fixture studio-y-up-axis && npm run simulator:workspace:check -- --fixture mesh-asset && npm run simulator:workspace:check -- --fixture hidden-object && npm run simulator:workspace:check -- --fixture xacro-source
scripts.simulator:blender:check:fixtures: npm run simulator:workspace:check -- blender --require-all --fixture demo && npm run simulator:workspace:check -- blender --require-all --fixture studio-y-up-axis && npm run simulator:workspace:check -- blender --require-all --fixture mesh-asset && npm run simulator:workspace:check -- blender --require-all --fixture hidden-object && npm run simulator:workspace:check -- blender --require-all --fixture xacro-source
scripts.simulator:genesis:prepare: sh -c 'PYTHON=${URDF_STUDIO_PYTHON:-}; if [ -z "$PYTHON" ]; then if [ -x .venv/bin/python3 ]; then PYTHON=.venv/bin/python3; else PYTHON=python3; fi; fi; "$PYTHON" -m backend.scripts.genesis_workspace_prepare "$@"' --
scripts.test:backend: sh -c 'PYTHON=${URDF_STUDIO_PYTHON:-}; if [ -z "$PYTHON" ]; then if [ -x .venv/bin/python3 ]; then PYTHON=.venv/bin/python3; else PYTHON=python3; fi; fi; if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then "$PYTHON" -m pytest "$@"; else "$PYTHON" -m pytest backend/tests; fi' --
